'''Brian Kallenbach Scum & Villainy''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Brian Kallenbach]]
* '''Published:''' October 1998 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber|JP-D-jabbaspalaceaudiencechamber.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Scum & Villainy
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PJP Scum & Villainy Kallenbach DS 1998.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck was designed for Brian Kallenbach's online Star Wars CCG Palace match with Rebel Base Leader Allen Divers (2-6pm, 10/2/98).

Strategy: This is a typical Dark Side Jabba's Palace deck - get the Palace going and use Gallid for drains. With an impressive 28 characters in the deck, Ability, Ability, Ability is a cinch to put into play and work to good effect. Throw in the combined power of Kithaba and Bane Malar, and you have a very good Mains and Toys killer.

Unlike most Scum And Villainy decks, this design contains the presence of the Dark Lord of the Sith. His job is to get to the Audience Chamber to stop Bo Shuda, and then sweep in with hordes of aliens and clean it out. Send Vader to Mist Hunter, and place him in as a pilot to get Scum And Villainy working again, or for a little bit of space support.
